note: فيم ستشعر is incorrect for 'how you'd feel'; use كيف ستشعر.
proposed_target: فكّر كيف ستشعر إن حدث ذلك لك.
proposed_english: Think about how you'd feel if that happened to you.

note: هذه الأمر has a gender mismatch, and English omits the explicit حل ('solve').
proposed_target: هذا أمر علينا أن نعمل معًا على حلّه.
proposed_english: This is something we need to work together to solve.

note: ما نحتاج is incomplete in standard MSA; use ما نحتاج إليه.
proposed_target: لا نملك من المال ما يكفي لشراء كل ما نحتاج إليه.
proposed_english: We don't have enough money to buy everything we need.

note: الواحد والوحيد is an unnecessary calque; الوحيد is natural MSA.
proposed_target: أنت الوحيد الذي يستطيع إنقاذ العالم.
proposed_english: You are the only one who can save the world.

note: انتهائك takes hamzat al-wasl, not إنتهائك.
proposed_target: يمكنك الذهاب للبيت بعد انتهائك من هذا العمل.
proposed_english: You can go home after you have finished this work.

note: Arabic says 'we don't have time for this, as you know'; English changes it to 'not much time right now'.
proposed_target: ليس أمامنا وقت لهذا كما تعلم.
proposed_english: You know we don't have time for this.

note: Sentence-initial امرأة should not carry accusative tanwin here; remove erroneous case marking.
proposed_target: امرأة مثلك لا تستحق رجلًا مثلي.
proposed_english: A woman like you doesn't deserve a man like me.

note: كم سيكون مدى خطورة is awkward; standard question is ما مدى خطورة.
proposed_target: برأيك، ما مدى خطورة هذه المهمة؟
proposed_english: How dangerous do you think this mission is going to be?

note: Demonstrative placement is wrong: المعرض هذا should be هذا المعرض.
proposed_target: كيف خطرت ببالك فكرة هذا المعرض؟
proposed_english: How did you come up with the idea for this exhibition?

note: كيف تعلم means 'how do you learn'; intended verb is تعرف.
proposed_target: كيف تعرف إن كان حساب بريدك الإلكتروني قد اختُرق؟
proposed_english: How do you know if your email account has been hacked?

note: الإجازة الماضية means last vacation, not last holiday season; verb construction is also awkward.
proposed_target: كم هدية تتوقع أنها تلقت خلال موسم الأعياد الماضي؟
proposed_english: How many gifts do you think she received last holiday season?

note: Arabic uses real future 'if this happens...what will you do?'; English shifts to remote hypothetical 'would'.
proposed_target: إن حصل هذا لأي سبب، فماذا ستفعل؟
proposed_english: If this happens for some reason, what will you do?

note: Arabic asks 'Who gave you the right...'; English asks 'What gives you the right...'.
proposed_target: من أعطاك الحق بأن تتحدث إلي هكذا؟
proposed_english: Who gave you the right to talk to me like that?

note: Current تعلم لم أنا لست is malformed; use explicit أنت تعلم لماذا لست.
proposed_target: أنت تعلم لماذا لست مضطرًا للقيام بهذا، أليس كذلك؟
proposed_english: You know why I don't have to do that, don't you?

note: أخذ مشروب لنفسك is an unnatural calque; use أن تحضر لنفسك مشروبًا.
proposed_target: لا تتردد في أن تحضر لنفسك مشروبًا إن كنت عطشانًا.
proposed_english: Feel free to get yourself a drink if you are thirsty.

note: Both sides use an incorrect conditional sequence; use past counterfactual forms.
proposed_target: لكان أخبرني بالحقيقة لو سألته.
proposed_english: He would have told me the truth if I had asked him.

note: Predicate adjective after أكون should be accusative قادرًا.
proposed_target: إذا فعلت ذلك، فقد أكون قادرًا على مساعدتك.
proposed_english: If you do it, I might be able to help you.

note: Use the natural contrast construction ليس المهم...بل... to express 'what counts'.
proposed_target: ليس المهم ما تقوله، بل ما تفعله.
proposed_english: It's not what you say, but what you do that counts.

note: تفعل أفضل ما لديك is an English calque; idiomatic Arabic is تبذل قصارى جهدك.
proposed_target: لا يهم ما تفعله، يجب عليك أن تبذل قصارى جهدك.
proposed_english: No matter what you do, you have to do your best.

note: أكون على تواصل معها is awkward; direct verb أتواصل is natural.
proposed_target: من فضلك أخبرني كيف يمكنني أن أتواصل معها.
proposed_english: Please tell me how I can get in touch with her.

note: Arabic هذا المتجر means 'this store'; English says 'that store'.
proposed_target: لا يمكنك أبدًا معرفة ما قد تجده في هذا المتجر.
proposed_english: You never can tell what you might find at this store.

note: عمن is the correct fused form; يستطيع is 'can', not conditional 'would'.
proposed_target: هل لديك أي فكرة عمن يستطيع فعل مثل هذا الشيء؟
proposed_english: Do you have any idea who can do this kind of thing?

note: Question is missing the copular relation; use a standard direct formulation.
proposed_target: ما أفضل طريقة برأيك لتسوية هذا النزاع؟
proposed_english: What do you think is the best way to settle this conflict?

note: Standard spelling is الاستماع, not الإستماع.
proposed_target: كل ما أستطيع فعله في الوقت الحالي هو الجلوس هنا والاستماع.
proposed_english: All I can do at the moment is sit here and listen.

note: English adds 'here', absent from Arabic.
proposed_target: ما أريده الآن هو الجلوس والاسترخاء.
proposed_english: All I want to do right now is sit and relax.

note: Current غايتي هي ألا تفعل ما تندم عليه is awkward and does not cleanly express future regret.
proposed_target: كل ما أريده هو ألا تفعل شيئًا ستندم عليه.
proposed_english: I just don't want you to do something you'll be sorry for.

note: Missing hamzas in أعتقد أنه; smooth the English construction as well.
proposed_target: أعتقد أنه كان من الخطأ ألا تأخذ بنصيحتي.
proposed_english: I think it was a mistake not to take my advice.

note: لو كنت أخبرتك is malformed for this hypothetical; use لو أخبرتك...لتفاجأت.
proposed_target: لو أخبرتك بالحقيقة، لتفاجأت.
proposed_english: If I were to tell you the truth, you would be surprised.

note: Missing preposition في after رغبتي.
proposed_target: دعني أخبرك سبب عدم رغبتي في فعل ذلك.
proposed_english: Let me tell you the reason I don't want to do that.
